section-sobre-mi.title: 🙋 About Me
section-sobre-mi.content: Full Stack Developer with over a year of hands-on production experience, specializing in PHP (Laravel), JavaScript, and MySQL. I have worked on two real-world projects from scratch in the edtech sector, covering everything from database design to REST API integration and front-end performance optimization. Additional training in AI and Big Data, and currently studying Web Application Development (DAW, graduating Jun. 2026). Looking to join a team where I can keep growing as a Full Stack Developer.
